requirement: DanceFlow policy: each dance is calculated independently and yields its own result; no combined championship placement exists, and an engine run covering none or several dances fails closed (COMP_ENGINE_UNSPECIFIED_CASE, multi_dance_unsupported, X-6). DanceFlow never infers an overall winner.
enforcement_point: Both Studio engines refuse danceIds.length != 1 (X-6); results are stored per round and dance with no aggregate column or reader.

tests.name: a single-dance run carries no overall, combined or aggregate field
X-6 none or several dances → unspecified
X-6 none or several dances → unspecified (also for a round that is not danced)
